dex.entry: A massive revived fossil-predator whose carapace has grown thick enough to shrug off cave-ins; it swings its tail like a wrecking ball and its eyes glow with a faint ancient light. The fossil that never should have woken up — ancient predator energy in a modern cave.

art.silhouette: Large quadruped; thick ridged stone-white carapace with deep limestone-cream and grey layering; broad low head with two faintly glowing amber eyes; heavy armoured tail; primordial and formidable.
